config.label: Apify API token, for example 'Bearer <apify-api-token>'
config.description: Apify API token, for example 'Bearer <apify-api-token>'. An account with a subscription is the recommended way to authenticate. Agents without an account can instead buy a prepaid, spend-capped token with agentic payments (x402, MPP, or Skyfire) at https://agi.apify.com.
